evidence.note: translateLevel projects one ColorSupportLevel into bits: has16m:=level>=3, has256:=level>=2, hasBasic:=true; level 0 becomes ColorInfo false rather than all-false flags.
Browser writes only the implied stack: truecolor sets all three true; basic sets hasBasic only. Combined-false and inverted stacks are never written.

notes: ColorSupportLevel 0|1|2|3 already exists; the three flags are the enabled levels flattened into bits (1=basic, 2=+256, 3=+16m).

disqualifier.note: Independent NLP backend capability flags; any subset is a legal advertised surface and composition unions them bitwise.
MCP tool-behavior hint wire mirror (readOnlyHint/destructiveHint/idempotentHint/openWorldHint); presets are convenience packs over the four independent SDK annotations.
Independent annotation-strata include toggles; any subset may be requested and defaults differ per flag.
Independent optional output-include toggles; IDF values and the document-term matrix may be requested together or separately.
Independent server config toggles for OTLP export vs Effect DevTools; all four combinations are legal deployments.
Independent reporter options: whether to render the cause vs whether to merge with existing reporters; both default true and combine freely.
Independently observed token facts; punctuation and stop-word status can co-occur or either can be false.
Independent executor toggles: cache is result-store lookup/write-through; trace is diagnostics. Docs treat them as separate axes.
Independent observed facts: conforms is the SHACL verdict; truncated is whether the violation list was cut. All four combinations are legal.
Pagination window facts derived from pageIndex/pageCount; first/middle/last/only pages make all 4 flag combinations legal. Coherence checks bind each flag to pageIndex, not to each other.
Independent detector inputs: isTTY is an observed stream fact; sniffFlags is a config toggle for argv sniffing. All combinations are legal.
Same independent isTTY fact plus sniffFlags toggle as the decision input; they are prepared heuristic inputs, not exclusive phases.
